responses.question: Is the radius-6, origin-centered circle the complete initial plotting scope, or one required example among others? Impact: this sets the minimum supported plot behavior. Proposed default: treat that circle as the sole required plotted example.

Are any graph ranges, input types, interaction, accessibility, or performance constraints required now? Impact: these create additional boundary/non-functional requirements. Proposed default: add none unless you specify them; preserve existing app conventions where relevant.

Does the circle test define the entire first version, or should the first version also support general 2D Cartesian expressions in a Desmos-like plotter? Impact: determines the core requirements. Suggested default: general 2D Cartesian expression plotting, with the specified circle as a required test case.

Which limits/constraints should the specification require (for example expression types, visible range, interactions, accessibility, or performance)? Impact: adds testable boundaries/NFRs. If none are known or required, say “none” or defer with a reason; I will not invent numerical limits.
